correctness.rationale: An explicit group-algebra coordinate substitution proves that the unmodified cube adjacency has N/2 Jordan two-blocks at eigenvalue parity(d). For odd d, the attachment induces a length-three nilpotent chain plus an invariant involutive complement. For even d, exact formulas for B^2 through B^5, the rank of B and the rank-two periodic image determine all nilpotent sizes and fixed dimensions. The Fitting decomposition gives every first-entry and least-period population and P(T=3)=1-1/q. The binary exact checker verified dimensions 1–8, and direct simulation exhausted 131624 labeled states for dimensions 1–4; finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: A canonical homogeneous graph has a dimension-parity split between fully reversible and square-zero neighbor-sum dynamics. Adding a single leaf generates a universal sharp length-three transient block, swaps the recurrent dimension from N-2 to 2 across the parity boundary, and gives a dimension-independent maximum-entrance fraction. The complete all-dimension census measures a natural and non-obvious boundary perturbation rather than an arbitrary table entry.
